token_spend_estimates.finding: Assumes 4,000 input + 500 output tokens per turn at Claude Sonnet rates ($3/$15 per M) = ~$0.0195 per turn. At 100 turns/user/month that is ~$1.95 (~GBP 1.50) per user; break-even with a $30 seat is ~1,540 turns/user/month.

Typical internal-assistant usage 2-5 requests/day, 1,500-3,000 tokens per conversation => roughly 150k-450k tokens per user per month. Unoptimised frontier-model deployments run $50-100+/user/month; after caching/routing target is low single digits to ~$15/user/month (~GBP 4-12).
Google partners estimate $15-40 per active power user per month in metered usage on top of Gemini Enterprise Plus seats.

Databricks gives each identified user 150 DBUs (~$10.50) of free LLM usage per month across Genie/Genie Code, implying Databricks sizes typical analyst-assistant consumption at roughly $10/user/month.

Generative answer = 2 credits ($0.02), tenant-graph-grounded answer = 10 credits ($0.10), autonomous action = 5 credits. 100 grounded answers per user per month = $10 (~GBP 8); the same agent can cost $8 or $800/month depending on build.
